Dog was closed outside for cleaning, at front of kennel, panting, neutral body. Wagged tail when spoken to. Easy to leash, pushed quickly out of kennel. Walked with moderate pull, alert to neighboring dogs but did not attempt to engage. Walked to main play yard without issue. In yard, dog remained on alert to surroundings, ears forward, chuffing. Explored on own for a few moments, patrolling fence line. Eventually came to handlers when called, soft face, wagging tail. Allowed all petting, leaned in for it. Grabby with treats. Handlers sat on bench, dog ran over and jumped onto bench between them, began rolling around against handlers, wide open mouth, wagging tail, seeking attention. Allowed all petting, very affiliative. After a few moments, another dog was walked outside of yard. This dog became very alert, forward posture, jumped from bench and charged fence, tense body, tail flagged. Appeared to lose sight of other dog but remained focused on corner of fence, chuffing. Dog began jumping up against fence as if to jump out of yard. Handlers approached, got dog's attention, retrieved leash without issue. On return, dog walked with moderate pull. Saw another dog a few yards ahead, stood still beside handler, tense body, watching. When handler began walking dog towards building, dog pulled hard in direction of other dog, needed moderate leash pressure to guide away. Handler kept leash short, used verbal coaxing while walking past kenneled dogs. This dog was alert but did not attempt to engage. Entered own kennel with light guidance, allowed leash removal by hand.

sections.evaluation_comments:
8/6/2026
Dog was laying down towards front of kennel; low growling; tense; whale eyed; tossed treats; dog started eating treats; began to settle; opened kennel door; tossed more treats; handler was able to place large loop over while dog ate treats; opened kennel door wide; dog retreated towards back corner of kennel; tossed more treats; came forward; ate treats; while dog ate treats; handler was able to place towel over; wrapped in towel; picked up; carried to yard; trembling. In yard, dog explored; distant from handler; tossed treats; not interested; verbally coaxed; continued to explore; dog walked past handler; slowly able to reach out; tolerated petting; more interested in yard; occasionally checked in with handler; neutral; tolerated petting. Handler crouched; tried verbally coaxing; not interested; handler slowly approached; dog stood still; slowly pet; walked away. Offered more treats; not interested; placed towel over; picked up; carried back to kennel; removed leash; placed back in kennel.
8/5/2026
Handler arrived to find the dog standing at the back of the kennel with a tense posture and exhibiting low growling. When the handler opened the kennel door and presented the leash, the dog increased growling and displayed bared teeth. During the handler’s attempt to place the leash, the dog snapped toward the leash and maintained a stiff body. The handler secured the leash using a large loop and applied light leash pressure to guide the dog toward the front of the kennel. Once at the front, the dog exited the kennel by jumping to the floor. The dog then walked on leash to the clinic while maintaining distance from the handler. In the clinic, the handler squatted and lifted the dog with a hand placed under its abdomen and then positioned the dog on the scale for a weight. The handler lifted the dog off the scale and removed the leash without issue before placing the dog into the clinic kennel.
8/4/2026
Dog was standing in corner, body tense, eyes wide, growling and alarm barking, settled briefly and came forward to eat treats, retreated again and continued alarm barking. Dodged and air snapped at leash, took a few attempts to place, once leashed dog began whining and crawling towards handler, as handler was trying to coax dog closer dog became tense and alarm barked, settled when handler presented towel, able to place over dog, grumbled as handler slowly picked up, carried to M&G room. Dog explored room, nose to ground, neutral, did not seek attention from handler but allowed handler to pet while walking by, stood next to door, interested in noises outside of room, dog then approached and sat underneath chair, allowed more pets, walked on leash back to kennel, able to pick up, remove leash and return with no issues.
8/2/2026
Pulled dog for AM cleaning. Staff in area reported dog was growling, baring teeth. Handler arrived, dog was standing in back of kennel with tense body. Began low growling. Sniffed towards treats but did not take. Handler opened gate, presented leash, dog growled louder, bared teeth. Handler attempted to leash dog, dog would snap towards leash, body stiff. Handler closed gate to give dog a moment; dog began alarm barking. Handler opened gate again, dog remained in back. Bit at leash a few times. Handler was able to secure leash with large loop. No issues loading dog into behavior tote. Carried to M&G room, removed top of tote. Dog air-scented, then jumped out. Urinated, defecated. Kept some distance from handler, paced around room, tail down. Handler softly coaxed, dog slowly approached, sniffed handler's legs. Briefly hid under chair, then came out and put front feet onto handler's leg, then hopped down and stood by handler. Allowed gentle petting on top of head and back, some light skin crawling. Resumed pacing room, handler was unable to keep dog's attention. Dog frequently stood by door, sniffing underneath. Handler was able to drape blanket, then lift and carry dog. Dog allowed some more petting on top of head, remained stoic. Returned to kennel, slowly removed leash by hand.
8/1/2026
Timid, tail tucked, allowed all handing and vaccines, whipped head at handlers hand when age checking, head shy, carried to kennel, slow leash removal.
